stem: Two cultivars occupy the same trellis. One branches aggressively while the other remains narrow. What is the best advanced management response?
choices: Use cultivar-specific placement and training decisions that preserve the shared canopy objective
Force both cultivars through identical cuts regardless of response
Increase irrigation only for the narrow cultivar
rationale: Canopy architecture is genotype-dependent, so consistent production goals may require cultivar-specific execution rather than identical treatment.
